summary: The selected runIterations<Width> is called from source dispatch by average row length and loops over requested iterations, launching once on each trip. Native code has the counter and actual CUDA launch/backedge in each of four instantiated widths (1,4,8,32). Each SASS variant processes batch, full-width remainder and tail entries before storing output. No graph/persistent loop.

source_evidence.claim: Kernel traverses row CSR entries in batches plus full-width remainder and tail, then stores output; runIterations invokes it once per requested iteration; dispatch passes iterations into Width 1/4/8/32 choice.

compiled_evidence.claim: Each of four runIterations specializations records timing and contains actual cudaLaunchKernel followed by increment/compare and a backedge until the passed limit; main selects the specialization by mean nonzeros per row and calls the selected function.
